# beszel_universal_token (Resource)

Manages a user's universal agent registration token. Singleton per user: Beszel's underlying endpoint is scoped to the caller's own record and forbids superuser callers, so the provider impersonates the target user to manage it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "beszel_universal_token" "example" {
  user      = beszel_user.example.id
  permanent = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user` (String) ID of the user this token belongs to.

### Optional

- `permanent` (Boolean) Whether the token persists across hub restarts. If false, it expires after an hour of hub uptime.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Token value. Left unset, Beszel generates one.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the token is currently active.
